document.name: Astoria Dance Center Classes
document.shortDescription: Long-running Astoria dance school with toddler, children’s, and teen classes plus summer afternoon dance programs.
document.longDescription:
Astoria Dance Center's official site says it has offered dance education since 1983 and currently serves children ages 2 through teens at 42-16 28th Avenue in Astoria. The official about and class descriptions pages list programs including Dance Together for 2's & 3's, Pre-Dance for ages 3-4.5, Pre-Ballet for ages 5-7, and older children's and teen classes in ballet, tap/jazz, hip-hop, Broadway Bound, performance team, modern, acting, music, and singing.

The official summer classes page specifically promotes summer afternoon dance classes, and the homepage notes the studio is open Mondays through Thursdays during summer hours. This supports weekday afternoon timing tags while avoiding unsupported weekend claims.

Sources: https://astoriadancecenter.com/ https://astoriadancecenter.com/adc-class-descriptions https://astoriadancecenter.com/about-us https://astoriadancecenter.com/summer-afternoon-classes https://img1.wsimg.com/isteam/ip/e5ed9ef3-bee7-46c5-8b11-3bfec22cbcd9/Serena%20ring%20jump.jpg
